subject: Evidence repo shrinkwrap + access delta plan
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence repo shrinkwrap + access delta plan

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We completed our initial SIG review and the portal inventory for Whistic/Vendr, and a few follow-ups popped up from our audit team: there are too many transient artifacts in the evidence repo (multiple snapshots, duplicate PDFs, and temp credentials) which is making our consumption and attestation noisy.

Can Redwood propose a lightweight approach to: (1) produce a compact manifest for each portal profile (one row per evidence item with canonical S3/URL), (2) reduce exposure by pruning stale temp credentials and capturing an access delta for the last 90 days, and (3) provide a short audit sample (proof of possession for a few CAIQ mapped controls).

We'd like to avoid a large project—target for a minimal, repeatable process that our auditors can consume by May 10. If you can share a short plan + a manifest template we can ingest into our tooling, that'd be ideal.

Attachments: example_inventory_export.csv (small sample)

Best,
Elena Park
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
ClearBridge Analytics

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence repo shrinkwrap + access delta plan

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick proposal below; happy to iterate.

Plan (high level):
- Week 1 (now–May 3): produce a compact manifest CSV that normalizes one evidence item per row (id, portal, field, doc_type, canonical_link, sha256, last_modified, owner). We'll map the manifest columns to CAIQ/SIG control ids so your auditors can crosswalk.
- Week 2 (May 4–May 10): run a pruning pass to identify stale transient artifacts and produce an "access delta" (list of principals with >0 access changes in past 90 days). We'll not delete anything without explicit OK; we will tag items with retention and suggested action.
- Deliverables: compact_manifest.csv, access_matrix.xlsx (access delta), and a 10-item audit sample (s3-manifest-sample.json) with proof-of-possession steps (signed timestamp + object hash).

Operational notes:
- We will pull evidence pointers from Vendr and Whistic export endpoints. If you prefer we can also publish a temporary presigned-bucket for the audit sample rather than pushing copies.
- Estimated effort: 3 engineer-days + 1 security SME day. If approved we can start tomorrow.

I've attached a draft manifest template and an access-matrix stub. Marissa/Rishi, tagging you for capacity and any compliance guardrails we should follow (retention approval, doc hashing).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-index.csv, access-matrix.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence repo shrinkwrap + access delta plan

Jonas —

This sounds reasonable and low-impact. Approve the scope you listed. Two small asks before we start:

1) Add one example audit trail (cloudtrail entry or object ACL change) to the "access delta" so auditors can see an event tied to the principal change.
2) Keep a separated staging bucket for the audit sample and limit TTL to 7 days; please provide a presign cadence for reviewer access.

I'll queue one of our compliance engineers to review the manifest mapping to SOC 2 control CC6.1 and SIG control sets. Rishi, please confirm that signed-hash is sufficient as proof-of-possession for your side.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence repo shrinkwrap + access delta plan

Thanks — that timeline works for us. We can ingest the compact_manifest.csv into our evidence pipeline (we'll share the ingestion schema).

A couple of clarifications:
- For proof-of-possession, signed-hash + presigned URL is acceptable. The auditors prefer if the manifest includes sha256 + size + last_modified.
- For access delta, include both human principals and service principals (token/service account) and indicate whether change originated from an IAM policy update vs. S3 ACL change.

I'll upload our small example_inventory_export.csv to the Vendr profile and share a link in the Drive folder. Once you send the manifest template we'll do a quick test ingestion.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: s3-manifest-sample.json (stub)
